shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore && echo ---- && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat "{}"' && echo ---- && ls node_modules | head -50

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80 && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme -name '*.js' | head; ls node_modules/react-router* 2>/dev/null | head -2; (npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15)

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/getRootClassName.js | head -30 && grep -n "ThemeProvider\|ThemeType\|export type Theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.js | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ ; grep -n "rem\|body" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles/styles.css 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ 2>/dev/null; rm -rf dist

grep -n "href\|view?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n "onUpdate\|checked\|content" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -o "Moon[A-Za-z]*\|Sun[A-Za-z]*" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; grep -n "\"@gravity-ui/icons\"" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

grep -n "ControlProps" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "variant" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "view" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -3
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i "^playwright\|^puppeteer" ; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer"; python3 -c "import playwright; print('py playwright ok')" 2>&1 | tail -1

mkdir -p /tmp/pwcheck && cd /tmp/pwcheck && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 240 npm i playwright@1 --silent 2>&1 | tail -3; timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; echo EXIT=$?
(npx vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort > /tmp/pwcheck/preview.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4173/
cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 120 node check.mjs

id -u; (sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && echo SUDO_OK) || echo NO_SUDO; (timeout 120 sudo -n apt-get install -y -q libglib2.0-0 >/tmp/pwcheck/apt.log 2>&1 && echo APT_OK) || (tail -2 /tmp/pwcheck/apt.log; echo APT_FAILED)

find / -name "libglib-2.0.so*" 2>/dev/null | head -3; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell 2>/dev/null | grep "not found"
pkill -f "vite preview" 2>/dev/null; cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 200 npm i jsdom@24 --silent 2>&1 | tail -2; echo JSDOM_DONE

cd /tmp/pwcheck && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild harness.tsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --jsx=automatic --loader:.css=empty --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --outfile=bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs; echo EXIT=$?

cd /tmp/pwcheck && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild harness.tsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --jsx=automatic --loader:.css=empty --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --outfile=bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs 2>&1 | head -80; echo EXIT=$?
cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs 2>&1 | head -80; echo EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
cd /tmp/pwcheck && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs 2>&1 | head -80; echo EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -6 && rm -rf dist && pkill -f "vite preview" 2>/dev/null; cd /tmp/pwcheck && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild harness.tsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --jsx=automatic --loader:.css=empty --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --outfile=bundle.mjs --log-level=warning && timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c "^PASS"; timeout 120 node run-jsdom.mjs 2>&1 | grep "^FAIL" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short
